scopeSuggestion.summary: Draft repair scope for trusted asset BENCH-901 (bench) at Riverside Park. Based solely on an unverified public report describing a cracked third seat slat that flexes under load, one exposed bolt, and splintering at the slat edge; no photo was attached. This draft proposes inspection, slat and fastener remediation, and documentation tasks. It is a proposal only: it has not been approved, no contractor or recipient is selected, and no funds are moved. Human review is required before any further action.
tasks: Conduct on-site inspection of bench BENCH-901 at Riverside Park to verify the reported condition of the third seat slat
Photograph the cracked slat, exposed bolt, and splintered edge before any work begins
Cordon or tag the affected bench pending review if the inspector confirms the reported flex and exposed hardware
Remove and retain the damaged third seat slat for disposal documentation
Install a replacement seat slat of matching material and dimensions
Replace or reinstall the exposed bolt with appropriate fasteners and confirm all seat slat fasteners are seated flush
Sand and deburr the repaired slat edges to address reported splintering
Apply weather-appropriate sealant or finish to the replacement slat if consistent with the bench's existing finish
Remove all work debris and old hardware from the site
Record completion photos, materials used, and labor time in the work log
safetyExclusions: No repair or replacement of bench frame, legs, or anchoring beyond the reported seat slat
No concrete, footing, excavation, or ground-anchoring work
No welding, cutting, or metal fabrication
No electrical work of any kind
No work at height using ladders, scaffolds, or elevated platforms
No use of specialized rigging or lifting equipment
No handling or remediation of suspected hazardous materials or treated-wood dust beyond standard shop practices defined by the reviewing party
No pest or biological contamination remediation
No modification of other benches or park assets
No structural assessment or load-rating determination; any such determination is outside this scope
requiredEvidence: Geotagged before-work photo of bench BENCH-901 showing overall condition
Close-up photo of the cracked third seat slat prior to removal
Close-up photo of the exposed bolt prior to remediation
On-site inspection note confirming or refuting the reported flex and splintering
Itemized receipt or procurement record for the replacement slat, fasteners, and consumables
Timestamped work log entries covering start, task completion, and site cleanup
Geotagged after-work photos showing the repaired slat and flush fasteners
Reviewer sign-off record from the human review step before any scope acceptance
assumptions: Asset identity, type, and location come from trusted metadata (BENCH-901, bench, Riverside Park); the report text is untrusted and used only as classification evidence
The reported damage is unverified until confirmed by on-site inspection
Scope assumes replacement of one seat slat and associated fasteners; additional damage found during inspection requires a revised scope
Replacement lumber and standard hand tools are locally available
Budget hint of 150000000 micro-USDC (approximately 150 USDC) covers materials, basic labor, and disposal for a single-slat repair and is a non-binding recommendation
All approvals, contractor selection, recipient designation, fund movement, and work acceptance occur outside this draft and require human review
